diagnosis.reason: Stock OpenCode 2.2.2 serve uses the default event bus with payload persistence disabled. It updates session history and aggregate sequence, but historical log replay only has the sync watermark.
diagnosis.correction: Subscribe to the native event stream with a server-side skill type filter before the single resume:false activation. After the handshake, verify the exact owned live event and read back the matching persisted message. Treat the historical sync marker only as a watermark.
